newsitem.title: JAPAN: BMW sees higher 1997 Japanese sales.
newsitem.headline: BMW sees higher 1997 Japanese sales.

text.p: BMW Japan Corp, the Japanese unit of Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW), is aiming to boost its Japanese sales to between 39,000 and 42,000 cars in 1997, up 7.4 percent to 15.7 percent from a year earlier.
Its 1996 sales rose 5.5 percent from a year earlier to 36,317 in 1996.
BMW Japan also plans to increase its sales outlets to 190 locations in Japan by 1999 from the present 161.
The company also hopes to sell 2,000 motorcycles in 1997, up from 1,780 a year earlier.
